state_cad_interface.claim_boundary: Offline action-interface audit on the frozen simulation P1v5 set. It tests whether the soft state-CAD likelihood changes posterior transport/coverage without using true center online. It is not dynamic insertion, hardware, or scale-transfer evidence.

cross_size_direction_interface.claim_boundary: Simulation-only zero-shot direction-interface audit. It does not prove state calibration, distance transfer, complete M10/M12 insertion, or hardware generalization.
cross_size_direction_interface.normalization: F/Fd, tau/(Fd*bit_radius), z/bit_radius plus per-channel phase shape

cross_size_full_loop_S2.claim_boundary: Simulation-only paired S2 audit inside size-specific synthetic visual 95% disks. It tests a frozen M8 direction learner with CAD-conditioned geometry and coverage, but retains simulation-initial control and terminal thresholds. A pass supports bounded zero-shot full-loop transfer in these MuJoCo fixtures; it does not establish probability calibration, real iiwa transfer, manufacturing tolerance, passivity, motor coupling, threaded unscrewing, or extraction. Oracle uses the true center only as an offline execution-feasibility upper bound.

strict_m8_complete_loop.claim_boundary: Frozen simulation-only M8 complete-loop audit conditioned on the declared ambiguous top-contact annulus. Strict success requires sensor-only handoff, offline-validated capture, CAD-bottom terminal verification, no hard stop, and completion within the shared 130 s active budget. It does not establish hardware transfer, passivity, motor coupling, threaded unscrewing, extraction, or universal superiority. Oracle is an upper-bound diagnostic; direct_first is not a physically reset retry baseline.

finite_grid_coverage_certificate.claim_boundary: This certifies geometric node coverage of the declared finite M8 visual-support disk by the padded action lattice. It does not certify compliant tracking, capture-cue detection, finite-time completion, CAD-bottom insertion, hardware chamfer attraction, or success after unsafe/budget interruption; those are audited by the measured-path controller and strict complete-loop rollout.

historical_capture_only_four_method_audi.claim_boundary: Frozen M8 simulation benchmark inside the declared visual prior. Position and bounded contact nuisances are unseen Sobol samples. When enabled, the F/T bias/noise/coupling/delay model is a pre-hardware engineering prior rather than a measured sensor distribution. Proposed and Baseline B share an identical first fingerprint and frozen learner. Baseline-B reset travel is not simulated or timed. Online handoff is sensor-only; MuJoCo geometry is used only for offline success scoring. This is not hardware evidence.

design.random_baseline: area-uniform seeded waypoints in the same visual disk; same XY speed, down-force, sensor-only handoff, path budget, and post-capture controller; no conical probe or learner
